Veltra Test Systems
VT-LD20
Pressure-decay leak tester
Operating and Maintenance Manual
Revision 3
For qualified maintenance personnel


1 Safety
1.1 General safety
Only qualified maintenance personnel may service the VT-LD20. Wear safety glasses when you work near the test
fixture, because the fixture is pressurised during a test. Never open the fixture while the tester is filling or a test is
running.
1.2 Lockout and tagout
Close the compressed air supply and fit your personal lock and tag on the tester pneumatic valve. Compressed air
stays in the lines and in the fixture after the supply is closed, so vent the lines and check that the gauge reads zero
before you open any fitting. Verify zero energy before you start.
Veltra Test Systems VT-LD20 Operating and Maintenance Manual, Revision 3
Page 2

3 Troubleshooting table
Find the symptom, then follow the remedy.
Symptom
Probable cause
Remedy
good parts failing leak test, reference off
pressure sensor drift
See 4.1 Recalibrate pressure sensor
(plant ref PROC-LT-01)
leak rate high on every part, fixture hissing

See 4.2 Replace fixture seals
(plant ref PROC-LT-02)
Veltra Test Systems VT-LD20 Operating and Maintenance Manual, Revision 3
Page 4


4 Procedures
4.1 Recalibrate pressure sensor
Plant ref: PROC-LT-01 | Lockout required: no | Time: 30 min
No isolation needed. Work from the HMI only.
1. Load the master part and start Calibration, then Reference, from the tester menu.
 2. Compare the reading with the reference gauge.
 3. Apply the offset if the difference is under 2 percent, otherwise replace the sensor with SENS-PRS-10.
 4. Run three master parts and confirm they pass.
 Parts required: none.
4.2 Replace fixture seals
Plant ref: PROC-LT-02 | Lockout required: yes | Time: 45 min
WARNING: Apply lockout and tagout before starting. Verify zero energy.
1. Close the air supply and apply lockout and tagout on the tester pneumatic valve.
 2. Remove the fixture plate and both test seals.
 3. Fit two SEAL-FIX-30 seals and refit the plate.
 4. Remove the lockout and run three master parts to confirm the leak rate is within limits.
 
Order no.
Description
Qty
SEAL-FIX-30
Leak test fixture seal 30 mm
2
